svg.title: tiny-llm architecture
svg.desc: A Machado de Assis sentence is tokenized with BPE (vocabulary 4,096), embedded, passed through six pre-norm Transformer blocks (multi-head causal attention with RoPE and grouped-query attention, then a SwiGLU feed-forward, both added to the residual stream), normalized, and projected by an output layer tied to the embedding into next-token probabilities; the probabilities shown are the real output of the fine-tuned run-2 model.
svg.text: a decoder-only Transformer, built from scratch
11.0 M parameters · 6 layers · d_model 384 · pretrained on 160 M tokens of 19th-century Portuguese, fine-tuned on Machado
each token id → a vector of 384 numbers
no position yet: RoPE adds it inside attention
pre-norm · each sublayer adds to the residual stream
how much of the content passes
same matrix as the token embedding (weight tying)
NEXT-TOKEN PROBABILITIES · SOFTMAX OVER 4,096 TOKENS · REAL OUTPUT, FINE-TUNED MODEL
